text: The initiative features a dedicated ILS regulatory framework that reduces legal uncertainty and frictional costs, a Pilot ILS Grant Scheme that subsidizes issuance costs and supports talent development, and a focus on nurturing talent through training programs and professional engagement. It aligns with Hong Kong's position as a global risk management center and has facilitated the issuance of several catastrophe bonds.

metadata.solution_name: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region’s Insurance‑Linked Securities (ILS) Regulatory Regime and Pilot ILS Grant Scheme
